instruction: In h-index the loop only counts a paper when its citations are strictly greater than the current h. Count them when they are greater or equal.
input:
(define (h-index citations)
  (foldl (λ (x h) (if (>= x h) (+ h 1) h))
         0
         (sort citations >)))
expected:
(define (h-index citations)
  (foldl (λ (x h) (if (> x h) (+ h 1) h))
         0
         (sort citations >)))
